purpose: Roll every mission-required gate up into one pass/fail table, against production freeze SHA 976a5650cbdf3bd4ce16fd86b7370bee30b341e4.

gates.requirement: Generic synthetic corpus (I1-I45) + injected-omission gates all pass, with zero package-specific hardcoding.
Every real validation run executes against a hash-verified frozen production tree; no post-freeze production drift.
gates.measured: SHA 976a5650cbdf3bd4ce16fd86b7370bee30b341e4, treeHash 199ba3f88e5bc31ae25572f6b59054c7f4733ab99dffad234d7c9a4601e4b5c1, 345 files; assertProductionFrozen() ran and passed at the start of every preserved real run.

gates.requirement: Validation A (holdout): 2 independent real runs completed against real, previously-unseen content, on the frozen production compiler.
gates.measured: run-1: $7.31, 8/8 regions attempted (7/8 compiled + verified, 1 provider failure); run-2: $7.59, 7/8 regions completed. Both post-RVD1-fix.

gates.requirement: Zero CRITICAL-materiality items that are captured in one holdout run and MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION in the other (mission §27 hard safety gate).
Disposition stability (same disposition on the same content-derived item across both holdout runs) >= 95% (mission §27).
gates.measured: 90.11% (82/91 items dispositioned identically); inventoryVariance=372 vastly exceeds compositionVariance=0, meaning instability is concentrated in what Pass A inventories per real-model run, not in how a shared item is dispositioned once inventoried.
gates.shortfall: 4.89 percentage points below the pre-registered 95% threshold

gates.requirement: Agreement-level status correctly downgrades to SEMANTICALLY_INCOMPLETE when any unit has a material MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION item or MATERIAL independent-verifier discrepancy (mission §26); rollup must not silently over-credit.
gates.measured: 0/16 real units (across holdout run-1, run-2, and whole-agreement run-1) achieved agreement-level SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE; every downgrade is traceable to a specific, disclosed reason (material MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION or independent-verifier MATERIAL discrepancy). Rollup logic verified operating correctly on real data.
gates.passBasis: the rollup mechanism itself is correct and conservative; the resulting SEMANTICALLY_INCOMPLETE outcome on real content is a substantive finding (see G5, G7), not a rollup defect

gates.requirement: The independent Phase 3C verifier must remain architecturally and operationally independent of the accountability/reconciliation layer (no shared trust).
gates.measured: PASS - independence held statically (import-boundary enforcement), at runtime (separate call path), and as observed in all real runs.

gates.requirement: 14/14 false-credit controls (mission §30) must hold - the system must never award trust/completeness it has not earned.
gates.measured: 14/14 controls pass (C1-C14), including the RVD-1 canonicalization-precision control (C3) added this session.

gates.requirement: Validation B (whole-agreement): 2 independent real runs + stability comparison across a full agreement, not just holdout regions (mission §22).
gates.measured: run-1 completed only 3/12 regions ($5.29 spent) before hitting an external Vercel AI Gateway account-level budget cap (HTTP 402, 'Current spend: $150.34, limit: $150.00'); run-2 and the stability comparison were never started. This is a provider-infrastructure block, not a code or architecture failure, and the user explicitly chose to stop and finalize with partial evidence rather than continue.
gates.note: Not conflated with a capability or architecture verdict; disclosed separately per mission discipline.

gates.requirement: Real-content validation of shared-capacity/cross-reference dependency remediation (mission §25), beyond the synthetic corpus.
gates.measured: NOT_MEASURED_ON_REAL_CONTENT - the holdout regions selected did not contain a real shared-capacity/cross-basket scenario, and the whole-agreement run that would have covered it stopped early (G9). Only synthetic I28/I29 coverage exists, which does not substitute for real-content validation per mission discipline.
gates.note: Downstream consequence of G9's early stop, not an independent defect.

gates.requirement: tsc / lint / vitest show zero regressions attributable to this workstream's code changes.
gates.measured: 0 new tsc errors, clean next lint, 0 semantic-accountability test files failing; all elevated vitest failures trace to a disclosed session-local DB-unavailability condition plus 2 pre-existing unrelated baseline failures.

gates.requirement: Independent audit of the whole workstream's claims and evidence (mission-required internal audit pass).
gates.measured: 17 findings (AUD-1..AUD-17): 14 pass, 2 pass-with-caveat (AUD-3 anti-enumeration prose caveat; AUD-16 audit was performed within the same session rather than by a separate/fresh agent), 1 fail (AUD-15, mirrors G10 - shared-cap real coverage).
gates.note: The single audit FAIL is the same underlying gap as G10, not a new independent defect.

gates.requirement: All spend decisions above the $12 mission threshold require explicit user authorization before proceeding (mission §29).
gates.evidence: conversation record: 3 AskUserQuestion check-ins this session (model substitution, tighter cap after budget check-in, stop-and-finalize after provider block)
gates.measured: Every threshold crossing was disclosed with concrete evidence and options before proceeding; final cumulative real-validation spend approx. $31.41 (holdout $7.05 discarded + $7.31 + $7.59, whole-agreement $5.29, plus the discarded Haiku run $4.17), all user-authorized in stages.
